rationale: Builds on the 1.5111 staged reverse-tail recurrent baseline without changing training throughput or export bytes. The best run trains the shallower recurrent replay at low gain but evaluates the tail at full strength; this tests the opposite side of the close capped-profile miss by giving only that shallower recurrent replay a modest super-unit gain at final validation. It preserves VAL_LOSS_EVERY=0, the exact final int8+zlib path, stable shapes, and the line cap.
title: Boosted Shallow Tail Eval Recurrence
